title: Harden file-backed persistence and transcript/session recovery
description: The 2026-07-11 swarm audit found weak recovery behavior around file-backed memory/event stores, transcript writes, and session teardown. Scope: add atomic write/retry semantics for file persistence, surface recoverable corruption clearly, and ensure session/transcript mutations have a consistent rollback or compensation path. Evidence: Data/Pages/audits/codebase-audit-20260711-swarm-synthesis.md, MemorySmith.Storage/FileEventStore.cs, MemorySmith.Storage/FileMemoryStore.cs, MemorySmith.App/Services/Training/ChatTranscriptWriter.cs, MemorySmith.App/Services/AgentSessions/AgentSessionService.cs.
